topics.title: Time and Work
topics.summary: Concepts of work-rate, inverse proportion, and combined work problems.

questions.questionText: A can do a piece of work in 10 days, and B can do the same work in 15 days. How many days will they take to finish the work together?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Calculate 1 day work for each.
• A's 1-day work = 1 / 10
• B's 1-day work = 1 / 15

Step 2: Combined 1-day work of (A + B):
= (1 / 10) + (1 / 15)
= (3 + 2) / 30 = 5 / 30 = 1 / 6

Step 3: Total days required = 1 / (1/6) = 6 days.
Hence, Option B is correct.

questions.questionText: A and B can together finish a work in 30 days. They worked together for 20 days and then B left. After another 20 days, A finished the remaining work. In how many days can A alone finish the work?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Work done by (A + B) in 20 days:
= 20 * (1 / 30) = 2 / 3 of the total work.

Step 2: Remaining work:
= 1 - (2 / 3) = 1 / 3.

Step 3: A finishes 1/3 of the work in 20 days.
Therefore, whole work done by A alone = 20 * 3 = 60 days.
Option D is correct.

questions.questionText: A is twice as good a workman as B and together they finish a piece of work in 18 days. In how many days will A alone finish the work?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Ratio of times taken by A and B = 1 : 2.
Let time taken by A = x days, and B = 2x days.

Step 2: 1-day work equation:
(1 / x) + (1 / 2x) = 1 / 18
3 / (2x) = 1 / 18
2x = 54  ==>  x = 27 days.

Thus, A alone can finish in 27 days.
Option A is correct.

topics.title: Problems on Trains
topics.summary: Speed, relative speed, distance, conversion between km/hr and m/sec.

questions.questionText: A train running at the speed of 60 km/hr crosses a pole in 9 seconds. What is the length of the train?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Convert speed from km/hr to m/s:
Speed = 60 * (5 / 18) = 50 / 3 m/sec.

Step 2: Distance = Speed * Time
Length of train = (50 / 3) * 9 = 150 metres.

Correct Answer: Option D.

questions.questionText: A train 125 m long passes a man, running at 5 km/hr in the same direction in which the train is going, in 10 seconds. The speed of the train is:
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Speed of train relative to man:
Relative speed = 125 / 10 = 12.5 m/sec.

Step 2: Convert relative speed to km/hr:
= 12.5 * (18 / 5) = 45 km/hr.

Step 3: Since both are moving in same direction:
Relative speed = Speed of train - Speed of man
45 = Speed of train - 5
Speed of train = 50 km/hr.
Option B is correct.

topics.title: Profit and Loss
topics.summary: Cost Price (CP), Selling Price (SP), Markup, Discount, and Percentage gains/losses.

questions.questionText: If cost price of 15 articles is equal to the selling price of 12 articles, what is the gain percent?
questions.explanation:
Let CP of each article = Rs. 1.
CP of 12 articles = Rs. 12.
SP of 12 articles = CP of 15 articles = Rs. 15.

Profit on 12 articles = 15 - 12 = Rs. 3.
Gain % = (3 / 12) * 100 = 25%.
Option B is correct.

topics.title: Syllogisms
topics.summary: Deductive reasoning, Venn diagram methods, and logical conclusions.

questions.questionText:
Statements:
1. Some mangoes are yellow.
2. Some tixo are mangoes.

Conclusions:
I. Some mangoes are green.
II. Tixo is a yellow.
questions.explanation:
From the statements:
- Nothing is stated about green mangoes, so Conclusion I cannot be assumed.
- No direct overlap between Tixo and yellow is guaranteed, so Conclusion II does not follow necessarily.

Hence, neither (I) nor (II) follows. Option D.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a photograph of a boy Suresh said, 'He is the son of the only son of my mother.' How is Suresh related to that boy?
questions.explanation:
Break down the statement:
• 'The only son of my mother' = Suresh himself.
• 'He is the son of Suresh'
Therefore, Suresh is the father of the boy. Option D is correct.

questions.questionText: A person covers a distance of 12 km at 4 km/h and another 15 km at 5 km/h. What is his average speed for the whole journey?
questions.explanation:
Total distance = 12 + 15 = 27 km.
Time 1 = 12 / 4 = 3 hours. Time 2 = 15 / 5 = 3 hours.
Total time = 6 hours.
Average speed = 27 / 6 = 4.5 km/h.
Option B is correct.
